subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class project/thread organization to the core Control UI now, and what Gateway/session transcript semantics should it expose?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow bug fix; it changes session metadata, transcript movement/copy rules, composer routing, and protocol shape.

options.title: Define core product/API first
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers specify the project/thread data model, routing API, and split/copy semantics before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to UI-only organization
options.body: Limit the scope to session labels, search, pinning, or grouping without transcript mutation or composer fanout.

options.title: Defer as not planned
options.body: Close the broader request and rely on existing session management, reply quotes, and checkpoint branching until stronger demand appears.

recommendation.title: Define core product/API first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers specify the project/thread data model, routing API, and split/copy semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and recently merged adjacent session-management work.
